payload.title: Configure canonical dashboard links for report artifacts
payload.description:
As an account operator, I want to configure the canonical dashboard base URL in existing account settings, so that generated report and artifact links open the correct deployed dashboard without adding backend resources.

Out of scope:
- GraphQL schema changes or new infrastructure resources.
- Artifact authorization or retention-policy changes.
- Persisting signed object-storage URLs.

Feature: Configure canonical dashboard links

Scenario: Save a valid dashboard base URL
Given an account has existing settings
When an operator saves an HTTPS dashboard base URL
Then the URL is stored under the reporting namespace
And all unrelated settings remain unchanged

Scenario: Leave the URL unset
Given an account has no canonical dashboard URL
When an operator saves the account settings
Then the reporting URL remains optional
And existing menu settings continue to work

Scenario: Reject an unsafe or malformed URL
Given an operator enters a non-HTTP web URL or a URL containing credentials
When the settings are validated
Then the account settings are not saved
And the operator sees an actionable validation message

Scenario: Preserve backward compatibility
Given an account only has legacy menu settings
When the dashboard reads those settings
Then the settings remain valid
And report-link configuration is treated as absent
